div.div:
Orange: external participant. Navy: transformation. Green open-ended symbol: retained data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. Bot/direct targets and
public-link creation/resolution are alternative sharing requests. Revocation, expiry, click updates and linked-message reuse are covered in sequences 37–38.
